suggestion.topic: Python AsyncIO vs Threading: When to Stop Blocking Your Event Loop
suggestion.rationale: Developers constantly misapply threading vs asyncio, leading to silent performance bottlenecks. Addressing this core concurrency confusion directly matches high-velocity search traffic and maximizes watch time via practical code contrast.
suggestion.hook_angle: Stop using Python threading for I/O bound tasks until you've seen what a single-threaded event loop can actually do.
